data.body:
[P2] Preserve matching historical records in text destinations

Retained DynamoDB and CloudWatch records from older exporters can still contain sub-millisecond timestamps; upgrading producers does not rewrite that history. A stored `2026-10-23T18:42:46.784500Z` previously matched `since: "2026-10-23T18:42:46.784119Z"`, but rounding the bound to `.785Z` now excludes it. Preserving precision for typed destinations only leaves this case unresolved. For legacy records, retrieve a sufficiently broad candidate set and compare timestamps at a common precision before applying the result limit. Restrict the fixed-width comparison to data guaranteed to use that format, and add mixed-precision history regression coverage.
